'''UP-S2''', also known as '''Yupee-Estoo''', was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable [[Courier droid/Legends|courier droid]] used by [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]]. UP-S2 had a supercilious personality, and was assigned to assist [[Green squad]] in monitoring communications from the [[Imperial Communications Center (Iyuta)|Imperial Communications Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iyuta]]. Due to the mission requiring communications silence, information gathered by Green squad was loaded in UP-S2 and launched on a [[Standard week/Legends|weekly]] basis to ''[[Home]]'', the Roughnecks' command [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="Missing" />
